heading: Services
intro: Everything from the first cut to the thumbnail.

items.title: Short form editing
items.body: Reels, TikTok and Shorts with hook-first structure, animated captions and sound design.

items.title: Long form editing
items.body: YouTube episodes, travel series and home tours with story structure, pacing and clean audio.

items.title: Motion graphics
items.body: Animated titles, maps, lower thirds and explainer sequences that match your brand.

items.title: Color grading
items.body: From flat log footage to a consistent look across every shot, camera and episode.

items.title: Shooting and live production
items.body: On-location filming and live stream production when a project needs footage, not just the edit.

items.title: YouTube thumbnails
items.body: Bold, readable thumbnails built to win the click at small sizes, with A/B variants on request.

items.title: Social media posts
items.body: Single posts and carousels for Instagram, Facebook and TikTok in one consistent style.

items.title: Banners and ads
items.body: Web banners and ad sets resized cleanly for every placement, from leaderboard to story.

items.title: Posters and print
items.body: Event posters, flyers and print pieces delivered press-ready with bleed and CMYK.

items.title: Brand identity
items.body: Logo, color palette and type system so every video and post looks like one brand.
